askOstler.title: Ask {{brand}}
askOstler.description: Ask a question about your projects. {{brand}} finds the tasks, comments, decisions and notes that answer it, and {{aiName}} answers from them.
askOstler.question: Question
askOstler.placeholder: What did we decide about the tiles?
askOstler.searchFilesHint: Also searches the text files in each project's linked folder, on this PC.
askOstler.stageQueries: Working out what to search for…
askOstler.stopped: Stopped. Ask again when you're ready.
askOstler.noSources: {{brand}} found nothing that matches this question.
askOstler.sourcesCut: Some sources were shortened or left out to keep the request small, so the answer may be incomplete.
askOstler.filesCutShort: The file search stopped early in at least one project (it looks at 5,000 files or 3 seconds per project), so some files were not searched.
askOstler.keywords: ask, question, answer, ai, find out
askOstler.earlierLeftOut: Older questions in this conversation were left out or shortened, to keep the request small.
askOstler.saveDescription: Keeps this conversation, with its sources, as a note in a project's Library.
askOstler.closeTitle: This conversation is not saved. Close?
askOstler.closeBody: Closing forgets these questions and answers. Save them as a note to keep them.

aiSetupDialog.openaiCompatibleAddressServer: The OpenAI-compatible address of the server, usually ending in /v1.
aiSetupDialog.apiKeyIfServer: API key (if the server needs one)
aiSetupDialog.storedEncryptedWindowsUser: Encrypted for your Windows user when Windows can. {{brand}} never shows it again.
aiSetupDialog.goodPlaceStart: {{recommendedModel}} is a good place to start.
aiSetupDialog.typeSearchEnterModel: Type to search, or enter a model ID.
aiSetupDialog.noModelIncluded: {{brand}} doesn't include or provide an AI model. It sends your requests to the model you connect. A provider's service handles them under its own terms and privacy policy, not {{brand}}'s, and {{brand}} can't control what happens to them once sent, so read that policy before you connect it. A model on this PC sends nothing anywhere.
aiSetupDialog.pcFreeNothingLeaves: On this PC: free, and nothing leaves the computer
aiSetupDialog.hasNoModelsYet: It has no models yet. Download one in {{presetLabel}}, then press Find it again.
aiSetupDialog.looksForAt: {{brand}} looks for {{provider}} at {{url}}, on this computer only.

aiSection.canSuggestTasksBreak: {{aiName}} can suggest tasks, break goals down, draft decisions and summarise your projects. It's optional: everything else works without it. Use a free model that runs on this PC, such as Ollama or LM Studio, or an account with an AI provider.
aiSection.appliesChatProjectNotes: Applies to {{aiName}} chat and the project notes chat.
aiSection.whatToldBeforeEvery: What {{aiName}} is told before every conversation.
aiSection.libraryImagesGoAi: Library images go to the AI provider when the model can read them. Otherwise, or if the provider refuses an image, {{brand}} sends each image's title, summary and caption instead and says so.
aiSection.whenSendsEachProjects: When on, {{brand}} sends each project's recent activity (changed file names, commit messages and authors, and tasks) to your AI provider on a timer, without asking each time. It's the only feature that contacts a provider by itself.
aiSection.lowerGivesSteadierAnswers: Lower gives steadier answers; higher gives more varied ones. 0.7 suits most uses.
aiSection.effortChecking: Asking {{model}}'s provider which levels it takes…
aiSection.effortNotSupported: {{model}} has no effort setting, according to its provider.
aiSection.effortFromListing: How hard {{model}} thinks before answering. The levels are the ones its provider lists for it.
aiSection.effortFromTest: How hard {{model}} thinks before answering. Its provider doesn't list levels, so each was tried with a one-word request; only the ones it accepted are offered.
aiSection.automaticSendImagesFall: Automatic (send images, fall back if refused)
aiSection.savedEnding_comment: {{hint}} is the last few characters of the saved API key.

aINextTasksModal.tickEditEach: Untick any you don't want and edit the rest in place. Adding them creates tasks only; nothing is queued for an agent.

aiBreakdownDialog.ostlerAiDidNot: {{aiName}} did not suggest any more work for this goal.
aiBreakdownDialog.oneThingCheckPer: One thing to check per line.
aiBreakdownDialog.tickEditEach: Untick any you don't want and edit the rest in place. The ticked ones are added to the backlog; nothing is queued for an agent.

aiTaskReview.title: {{name}} title
aiTaskReview.everyTickedTaskNeeds: Every ticked task needs a title

aiDecisionDialog.editAnythingWrongNothing: Edit anything that is wrong. Nothing is added to the decision log until you save it.

aiSummarySection.canSumUpPlan: {{aiName}} can sum up your plan and agent activity as risks and next steps. It can't queue tasks or control agents.
aiSummarySection.summaryDescribesProjectWas: This summary describes the project as it was {{when}}, not as it is now. Refresh it before acting on it.
aiSummarySection.everyRecommendationSummaryWas: Every recommendation in this summary was approved and added.
aiSummarySection.recommendationsApproveOneBefore_one: {{count}} recommendation. Approve one before you create a goal, milestone or task from it.
aiSummarySection.recommendationsApproveOneBefore_other: {{count}} recommendations. Approve one before you create a goal, milestone or task from it.
aiSummarySection.constraintsFeedbackBeforeRegenerate: Constraints or feedback before you regenerate it
aiSummarySection.createTaskQueueAgent: Create a task, queue it for an agent and show its prompt

agentPlanWizard.planSplitIntoTasks: Plan "{{goalTitle}}" and split it into tasks
agentPlanWizard.draftsPlanGoalSummary: {{aiName}} drafts a plan for this goal: a summary, an audit against the work that already exists, rules every task must keep, and a list of phases. No tasks yet: you approve the plan before the longer task split runs.
agentPlanWizard.eachPhaseSplitTurn: Each phase is split in turn, seeded with what the earlier phases already planned. It runs in the background: you can close this window, and you are told as each phase lands.
agentPlanWizard.untickAnythingDontWant: Untick anything you don't want created. A task that relies on an unticked one loses that link.
agentPlanWizard.tasksNothingLeftWait: Tasks with nothing left to wait for were queued straight away; the rest queue on their own once the tasks they depend on are done.
agentPlanWizard.couldntLoadFinishedSplit: Couldn't load the finished split. Try again.
agentPlanWizard.couldntGeneratePlanTry: Couldn't generate the plan. Try again.
agentPlanWizard.couldntSplitIntoTasks: Couldn't split into tasks. Try again.
agentPlanWizard.couldntRetryPhaseTry: Couldn't retry that phase. Try again.
agentPlanWizard.couldntCancelSplitTry: Couldn't cancel the split. Try again.
agentPlanWizard.couldntCreatePlanTasks: Couldn't create plan tasks. Try again.
agentPlanWizard.chooseWhatOstlerAi: Choose what {{aiName}} reads while it plans.
agentPlanWizard.reviewPlanPhasesBefore: Review the plan and the phases before any task is written.
agentPlanWizard.phasesBeingSplitInto: The phases are being split into tasks.
agentPlanWizard.checkTasksThenCreate: Check the tasks, then create them.

librarySourcesStep.readsTheseWhilePlans: {{aiName}} reads these while it plans. Coding agents can't see the Library, so each task it writes says in words what it needs from them.
librarySourcesStep.nothingSetAlwaysBriefs: Nothing is set to Always. Briefs and guides are by default.
librarySourcesStep.imagesWillSentAi_one: {{count}} image will be sent to the AI provider
librarySourcesStep.imagesWillSentAi_other: {{count}} images will be sent to the AI provider
librarySourcesStep.imagesWillSentDescriptions: Images will be sent as descriptions: this model can't read images.
librarySourcesStep.checkingWhetherModelReads: Checking whether the model reads images…
librarySourcesStep.imagesSentSomeLeftOut_one: {{count}} image will be sent to the AI provider ({{dropped}} over the limit left out)
librarySourcesStep.imagesSentSomeLeftOut_other: {{count}} images will be sent to the AI provider ({{dropped}} over the limit left out)
